title: How to organise the coat and outerwear zone | Entryway
description:
Hold the outerwear you will actually wear this week, at the moment you reach for it.

This is the Coat and Outerwear Zone in the Entryway. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
One coat per person on the rail, one bag, hats and gloves together in a single labeled bin on the shelf above, umbrellas standing in the stand, and at least two hooks left empty.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Take every coat down.
Straighten: Hooks for what goes on and off daily, hangers only for the wool coat that creases.
Shine: Brush the shoulders of the hanging coats, wipe the shelf where dust settles on top of the hat bin, and tip out
Safety: Hang your full weight on each hook before you trust it with a soaked winter coat.
Standardize: Write the contents and the season on the shelf bin, hats and gloves, winter, so whoever reaches up for it in O
Sustain: When you put a wash on, walk the rail on your way past and return anything that has been left over a chair bac

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Two empty hooks at all times.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/entryway-the-coat-and-outerwear-zone.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
